problem_type: Tax-efficient equity structure design for a multinational enterprise

decisions.business: Direct parent node of each country (0 denotes the virtual root node, i.e., the country is the top-level parent company). example: {"1": 0, "2": 1, "3": 1, "4": 2}. List all N countries with profit greater than 0; the target country must point to 0
Net dividend amount each country sends to its parent node. example: {"1": 1500.5, "2": 800.0, "3": 450.2, "4": 200.0}. List all N countries with profit greater than 0

Additional foreign income tax each country must pay due to dividends received from its child nodes. example: {"1": 45.0, "2": 0.0, "3": 12.5, "4": 0.0}. List all N countries with profit greater than 0
